hero.title: Build a career with direction
hero.subtitle: Clarity, strategy, and momentum for your next move.
hero.body: From job search to long-term growth, Horizon helps you understand where you stand, choose the smartest next step, and keep moving with confidence.

proof.guidance: A calm workspace for applications, companies, documents, and decisions.
proof.documents: AI-assisted CV, cover letter, and role-specific document preparation.
proof.practice: Interview practice and follow-up planning tied to real opportunities.

pillars.title: Less noise. More useful next steps.
pillars.subtitle: Horizon is not a one-time job search tool. It is a structured career workspace for the decisions that shape your next role and the one after it.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.body: See your pipeline, role fit, company context, and risks without switching between scattered notes and spreadsheets.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.body: Turn job descriptions, company research, and your profile into sharper positioning, tailored documents, and better questions.

momentum.title: Momentum
momentum.body: Know what to do today: follow up, prepare, improve a document, research a company, or move an opportunity forward.

workspace.title: Everything around an opportunity lives in one guided flow.
workspace.body: Horizon connects the work candidates already do: research, tracking, CV editing, cover letters, interview preparation, and offer thinking. The AI guide supports the workflow without turning the product into a noisy chat screen.

applications.title: Applications

pricing.eyebrow: A product people can grow into
pricing.title: Start simple, pay for serious career leverage.
pricing.body: The first paid layer should earn its place: stronger document generation, deeper role research, interview coaching, and a Horizon Guide that understands the user’s whole career context.
pricing.planBody: For active job seekers and ambitious professionals who want structure, better decisions, and less manual work.

closing.title: Build the next move with direction, not reaction.
closing.body: Horizon helps people move through job search and long-term growth with a calmer system, clearer decisions, and steady progress.

drawer.placeholder: Ask anything about your career workflow...
drawer.welcomeBody: I can help with pipeline summaries, follow-up strategy, and interview preparation. Try asking for a next best action.

responses.interviewBody: Build a 30-60-90 narrative and rehearse STAR answers focused on ownership and ambiguity.
responses.fallbackBody: Try: summary, next action, follow-ups, or interview prep.
